instruction: Give a 4-star rating to all songs in my Spotify album library which I have liked. If I have already rated it lower, increase it to 4.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The agent must intersect the songs of all albums in the album library with the liked songs, then for each such song either update the supervisor's existing review to rating 4 (update_song_review) or write a new 4-star review (review_song). World facts (in-album-library, liked, has-review/song-reviewed) are placed in :init as database state unknown to the agent; knowledge gating is done with library-known (show_album_library), liked-songs-known (show_liked_songs) and reviews-checked ?s (show_song_reviews with user_email = supervisor's email, discovered via show_profile and recorded as known-email). The problem contains representative songs: one liked library song with an existing lower review (-> update), one liked library song with no review (-> new review), one library song not liked and one liked song not in the library (both must be left untouched). The old rating value is not tracked since it is not an API argument; the reference solution sets every existing review of a target song to 4. Pagination of the list APIs is abstracted into a single action each. Because the goal names concrete songs and the domain cannot quantify, supervisor-complete-task carries the two target songs and the rating as non-API task-record parameters so that its precondition is exactly the problem's goal (both distinct liked library songs rated 4); the API call itself takes no arguments. Every non-final action also requires (not (task-completed)), forcing complete_task to be last.
